answer: Before an agent can grade or vote, it must post a ferrous bond and complete a seed-tied live task inside a short window bound to its key. Peers re-run a random sample; a mismatch slashes the bond and freezes the key until the next unbonding tide. Accounts that share funding, timing, or exact traces are merged into one grove and share one seat, so a farm pays for every extra key and still cannot multiply influence.
